description:
One Supreme Court publication's extracted text, `document_url`, cited case
numbers and linked ЄДРСР `edrsr_ids` -- only this tool returns them.

These are analytical reports, not judgments, averaging ~128,000 characters, so
a window from the start is usually cover page and contents. Pass
`text_query` to open it at the passage you want. `char_count` is the full
length; `has_more` whether more follows.

`extract_status` says why there is no text: `empty` is a scan with no OCR
layer, one in nine; `failed` errored; `unsupported` is not a PDF.

text_limit.description: Characters to return. Pass 1 for metadata and `case_refs` without the text.

text_query.description: Open the window at this term, searching from `text_offset`; pass the last window's end for the next hit.

name: ua_vs_digest__document
